translated_text: Bremen, October 29, 1932. That was once upon a time, my dear! I spent two hours at the swimming pool and swam until I was completely exhausted. Apart from the fact that this is quite healthy for a change of pace, I desperately need it, as all the driving has caused my tummy to develop into a bulge (it happens from driving so fast). It's a good thing I can't have children, otherwise I'd almost have this worry. How vain Bob is! Every morning, as long as I'm not too lazy, I do 10-15 minutes of exercise, and gymnastics helps me get back into shape. I hear all the best from home; Papa is driving. Yesterday he went to Zagreb and is coming back via Budapest and Prague. He hopes to find a way to continue his travels to those countries. Egge is now gone with Ernst & the Chrysler Intern. I've also had jewelry made at home, similar to the necklaces: (earrings, cufflinks, and pins). It's become a sensation. I'm also selling these items quite well. Otherwise, business is unfortunately bad; it's a real shame that there's now an import ban on such goods in Paris, otherwise I would definitely go there. The political situation here remains very bleak. There are elections again on November 20th, and nobody knows what will happen. The confusion is so great that you can't even make sense of it yourself anymore. It would be very desirable, economically speaking, for a little bit of clarity to emerge after the election, both parliamentaryly and politically, even if it comes at the expense of socialism. You can imagine how confused everything is when I myself agree to this compromise. By the way, someone personally slept in the room next to mine last night. The hotel was constantly besieged by all sorts of locusts, and it was a mixed feeling; it was a very strange feeling to be stared at by the crowd when you came out of the hotel. But not unpleasant. Tonight I'll probably go to a pretty good cabaret here, as there are some very excellent people there. And tomorrow, my first stop will be the post office to see if my Gabins has written. Lots of love, Your Bob EMER 001070 10 五 === /////// 三三 Jl. MENS 5 10 10 10 10 Elisabeth Aigner Paris 6e 59 rue de seine "Hotel des Pyrénées" Zweigenthal Pforzheim HOTEL NORDISCHER HOF BREMEN. Germany.
